D.name: Deterministic query complexity
D.short: Minimum worst-case number of queries of a deterministic decision tree computing f.

D_size.name: Decision tree size
D_size.short: Minimum number of leaves of a deterministic decision tree computing f.

PDT.name: Parity decision tree complexity
PDT.short: Decision tree depth when each query may read the parity of an arbitrary subset of bits.

s.name: Sensitivity
s.short: Max over inputs of the number of coordinates whose flip changes the output.

bs.name: Block sensitivity
bs.short: Max number of disjoint blocks of coordinates each of whose flips changes the output.

fbs.name: Fractional block sensitivity
fbs.short: LP relaxation of block sensitivity; equals the LP relaxation of certificate complexity by duality.

C.name: Certificate complexity
C.short: Max over inputs of the smallest partial assignment that fixes the value of f.

C0.name: 0-certificate complexity
C0.short: Largest minimal certificate over 0-inputs; the co-nondeterministic query complexity.

C1.name: 1-certificate complexity
C1.short: Largest minimal certificate over 1-inputs; the nondeterministic query complexity.

Cmin.name: Minimum certificate complexity
Cmin.short: Min (rather than max) over inputs of the smallest certificate.

UC.name: Unambiguous certificate complexity
UC.short: Certificate complexity where the certificates form a partition-like unambiguous cover.

UCmin.name: Minimum unambiguous certificate complexity
UCmin.short: The cheaper of the two one-sided unambiguous certificate complexities.

SP.name: Subcube partition complexity
SP.short: Smallest k such that the cube can be partitioned into monochromatic subcubes of codimension <= k.

RC.name: Randomized certificate complexity
RC.short: Cost of a randomized verifier that must detect, with constant probability, that the input has been changed to flip f.

EC.name: Expectational certificate complexity
EC.short: A relaxation of certificate complexity in which the certificate is a distribution and only expected agreement is required.

D_prod.name: Product-distribution distributional complexity
D_prod.short: Max over *product* input distributions of the bounded-error distributional query complexity.

Dmu.name: Distributional query complexity
Dmu.short: Least depth of a deterministic tree that is correct except with probability eps under the input distribution mu.

FC.name: Fractional certificate complexity
FC.short: LP relaxation of certificate complexity: fractional weights on coordinates that must cover every disagreement.

cbs.name: Critical block sensitivity
cbs.short: Block sensitivity of a search problem: the adversary picks the input, but the algorithm picks which valid answer to commit to.

rank.name: Decision tree rank
rank.short: The "Strahler number" of a decision tree: how much branching, rather than how much depth, the tree needs.

Dna.name: Non-adaptive deterministic query complexity
Dna.short: Fewest queries when the whole query set must be fixed in advance.

R.name: Bounded-error randomized query complexity
R.short: Worst-case number of queries of a randomized decision tree that errs with probability at most eps.

Rbar.name: Expected-cost randomized query complexity
Rbar.short: Same as R_eps but the cost is the expected (not worst-case) number of queries.

R0.name: Zero-error randomized query complexity
R0.short: Expected number of queries of a randomized algorithm that is always correct.

R1.name: One-sided-error randomized query complexity
R1.short: Randomized complexity when errors are allowed on only one side.

RS.name: Sabotage complexity
RS.short: Randomized cost of finding a "sabotaged" (damaged) input bit; the first measure with perfect composition.

chi.name: Conflict complexity
chi.short: A measure of how hard it is for a decision tree to distinguish a random 0-input from a random 1-input, one query at a time.

chibar.name: Max-conflict complexity
chibar.short: A strengthening of conflict complexity that dominates sabotage complexity.

LR.name: Linearised randomized complexity
LR.short: The largest measure satisfying an inner composition theorem R(f o g) = Omega(R(f) LR(g)).

noisyR.name: Noisy randomized query complexity
noisyR.short: Randomized complexity when the algorithm may buy a biased (noisy) copy of any bit at cost proportional to bias squared.

noisyRna.name: Non-adaptive noisy randomized query complexity
noisyRna.short: The bias-purchasing model with the whole schedule of biases committed to in advance.

Corr.name: Correlated samples complexity
Corr.short: Distributional complexity when the algorithm may query as many independent samples from the same side as it likes.

Sel.name: Selection complexity
Sel.short: Cost of solving *any one* of k independent instances, with k chosen by the algorithm and the instances drawn from the hardest distribution.

Rstar.name: Asymptotic composition rate
Rstar.short: lim_k R(f^{o k})^{1/k}: the per-level cost of composing f with itself many times.

Np.name: Noisy decision tree complexity
Np.short: Number of queries when every query answer is independently flipped with probability p.

CA.name: Classical adversary bound
CA.short: The classical analogue of the positive-weights quantum adversary; a lower bound on R.

CG.name: Certificate game complexity (private coin)
CG.short: Inverse winning probability of a zero-communication game where two players must agree on a coordinate where their inputs differ.

CGpub.name: Certificate game complexity (public coin)
CGpub.short: Public-coin version of the certificate game; equals the classical adversary bound.

CGns.name: Non-signaling certificate game complexity
CGns.short: Certificate game with arbitrary non-signaling correlations; the weakest of the four.

psD.name: Pseudo-deterministic query complexity
psD.short: Randomized cost of a search algorithm that must output the *same* canonical answer with high probability on every input.

Rna.name: Non-adaptive randomized query complexity
Rna.short: Bounded-error cost when the query set is drawn from a distribution fixed in advance, independent of the answers.

Q.name: Bounded-error quantum query complexity
Q.short: Number of applications of the phase/bit oracle O_x needed to compute f with error <= eps.

QE.name: Exact quantum query complexity
QE.short: Number of queries of a quantum algorithm that outputs f(x) with probability 1.

Q0.name: Zero-error (Las Vegas) quantum query complexity
Q0.short: Quantum algorithm that never errs but may output "don't know" with probability <= 1/2.

PostQ.name: Post-selected quantum query complexity
PostQ.short: Quantum queries when the algorithm may post-select on an exponentially unlikely event.

QC.name: Quantum certificate complexity
QC.short: Quantum analogue of certificate complexity; the square root of RC.

NQ.name: Nondeterministic quantum query complexity
NQ.short: Quantum algorithm with nonzero acceptance probability exactly on 1-inputs.

robustQ.name: Robust quantum query complexity
robustQ.short: Quantum queries when the oracle is noisy (each query answer is corrupted).

Adv.name: Positive-weights adversary bound
Adv.short: The original quantum adversary lower bound; all positive-weight variants coincide.

Advpm.name: General (negative-weights) adversary bound
Advpm.short: The tight SDP characterisation of bounded-error quantum query complexity.

gamma2.name: Approximate gamma_2 norm
gamma2.short: Factorisation-norm formulation of the general adversary bound.

MAdv.name: Multiplicative adversary
MAdv.short: A multiplicative-weight version of the adversary method, at least as strong as Adv^pm.

lambda.name: Spectral sensitivity
lambda.short: Largest eigenvalue of the adjacency matrix of the sensitivity graph of f.

deg.name: Exact degree
deg.short: Degree of the unique multilinear real polynomial that represents f exactly.

adeg.name: Approximate degree
adeg.short: Least degree of a polynomial that approximates f pointwise to within eps.

sdeg.name: Sign degree
sdeg.short: Least degree of a polynomial whose sign agrees with f everywhere.

rdeg.name: Rational degree
rdeg.short: Least d such that f = p/q on the domain with deg(p), deg(q) <= d.

ardeg.name: Approximate rational degree
ardeg.short: Bounded-error version of rational degree; equals post-selected bounded-error quantum query complexity.

ndeg.name: Nondeterministic degree
ndeg.short: Least degree of a polynomial that is nonzero exactly on the 1-inputs.

deg2.name: Mod-2 degree
deg2.short: Degree of f as a multilinear polynomial over F_2.

cjdeg.name: Conical junta degree
cjdeg.short: Least d such that f is approximated by a non-negative combination of width-d conjunctions (a conical junta).

odeg.name: One-sided approximate degree
odeg.short: Approximate degree when the polynomial only has to be *large* on 1-inputs, not close to 1.

Var.name: Variance
Var.short: How far f is from constant. Not a complexity measure -- the unit the other Fourier quantities are divided by.

Inf.name: Total influence (L2 influence)
Inf.short: Expected number of sensitive coordinates on a uniformly random input; equals sum_S |S| fhat(S)^2.

Inf1.name: Total L1 influence
Inf1.short: Sum over i of E_x |D_i f(x)|; differs from total influence for bounded real-valued f.

osss.name: OSSS number
osss.short: Var(f)/MaxInf(f): the query lower bound the OSSS inequality reads off the influences.

NS.name: Noise sensitivity
NS.short: Probability that f changes when each bit is flipped independently with probability delta.

Stab.name: Noise stability
Stab.short: Correlation of f(x) and f(y) for rho-correlated x,y.

nsr.name: Noise robustness
nsr.short: One over the noise rate at which f starts to break: the query-scale reading of NS_delta.

L1.name: Spectral norm
L1.short: Sum of absolute values of the Fourier coefficients.

Fdim.name: Fourier dimension
Fdim.short: Dimension of the F_2-span of the Fourier support.

prt.name: Partition bound
prt.short: LP relaxation of "cover the cube by few low-codimension monochromatic subcubes"; subsumes most classical lower bound techniques.

rprt.name: Relaxed partition bound
rprt.short: The partition bound with the "fires with probability exactly 1" constraint relaxed to "at most 1"; weaker, but unlike prt it lower-bounds information complexity.

R1RP.name: One-sided randomized queries with certain rejection
R1RP.short: Negative inputs always reject; positive inputs accept with probability at least 2/3.

QSweak.name: Weak quantum sabotage complexity
QSweak.short: Quantum queries to distinguish stars from daggers in a sabotaged input, without access to its completions.

QSstr.name: Strong quantum sabotage complexity
QSstr.short: Quantum sabotage decision with query access to both opposite-output completions.

QSweakind.name: Weak quantum sabotage index complexity
QSweakind.short: Find a sabotaged coordinate with quantum access to the sabotaged string alone.

QSstrind.name: Strong quantum sabotage index complexity
QSstrind.short: Find a sabotaged coordinate with quantum access to both completions and the sabotaged string.

QEcert.name: Exact quantum certification complexity
QEcert.short: Worst-case exact quantum query cost of recognizing a known input against all opposite-output inputs.

Q0cert.name: Zero-error quantum certification complexity
Q0cert.short: Zero-error quantum cost of the certification task; equivalent to its exact quantum cost.

bdeg.name: Exact bounded polynomial degree
bdeg.short: Exact degree with the polynomial also constrained to [0,1] on the entire Boolean cube.

lambdacert.name: Spectral sensitivity certification
lambdacert.short: Spectral sensitivity of the hardest known-input certification promise; exactly the square root of sensitivity.

degcert.name: Bounded degree certification complexity
degcert.short: Worst exact bounded degree of a known-input certification promise; a new lower bound on zero-error quantum queries.

osdeg0.name: Bounded polynomial degree with error on 0-inputs
osdeg0.short: A polynomial bounded in [0,1], exact on 1-inputs and approximate on 0-inputs.

osdeg1.name: Bounded polynomial degree with error on 1-inputs
osdeg1.short: A polynomial bounded in [0,1], exact on 0-inputs and approximate on 1-inputs.

osdeg.name: One-sided-error bounded polynomial degree
osdeg.short: The maximum of the two bounded one-sided-error degrees; lower-bounds zero-error quantum queries.

settings.name: Total functions
settings.blurb: f : {0,1}^n -> {0,1} defined on the whole cube. Where all measures are polynomially related.

settings.name: Partial functions
settings.blurb: f : Dom(f) -> {0,1} with Dom(f) a proper subset of the cube (promise problems). Most polynomial relations FAIL here.

settings.name: Relations
settings.blurb: f subset of {0,1}^n x O : any output o with (x,o) in f is acceptable. Search problems, TFNP-style.

chip_names.theta: tight up to constants in both directions

chip_lo_names.exact: a family attains M1 >= M2^a exactly, with no constant loss
chip_lo_names.tilde: a family with M1 = Omega-tilde(M2^a): tight up to logs
